entries.heading: Section 5 of the Protecting and Securing Chemical
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 16007.  Section 5 of the Protecting and Securing Chemical 
Facilities from Terrorist Attacks Act of 2014 (Public Law 113-254; 6 
U.S.C. 621 note) is amended by striking ``the date that is 5 years and 3 
months after the effective date of this Act'' and inserting ``July 23, 
2020'':  Provided, That the amount provided by this section is 
designated by the Congress as being for an emergency requirement 
pursuant to section 251(b)(2)(A)(i) of the Balanced Budget and Emergency 
Deficit Control Act of 1985.
